name: qwen-max
description: Qwen Max is a Qwen 2.5 series large language model with hundreds of billions of parameters, supporting inputs in Chinese, English, and other languages. The model is continuously updated as new improvements become available. For consistent behavior and reproducible results, use a dated snapshot version.
zhDescription: 千问2.5系列千亿级别超大规模语言模型，支持中文、英文等不同语言输入。随着模型的升级，qwen-max将滚动更新升级。如果希望使用固定版本，请使用历史快照版本。
longDescription: Qwen Max is a Qwen 2.5 series large language model with hundreds of billions of parameters, supporting inputs in Chinese, English, and other languages. The model is continuously updated as new improvements become available. For consistent behavior and reproducible results, use a dated snapshot version.
zhLongDescription: 千问2.5系列千亿级别超大规模语言模型，支持中文、英文等不同语言输入。随着模型的升级，qwen-max将滚动更新升级。如果希望使用固定版本，请使用历史快照版本。

modelParameters.description: 存在惩罚，鼓励模型讨论新话题

modelParameters.label: Top P
modelParameters.description: 核采样参数，控制候选词汇的范围

modelParameters.label: Max Tokens
modelParameters.description: 单次生成的最大 token 数量

modelParameters.label: Frequency Penalty
modelParameters.description: 频率惩罚，减少重复内容的生成

modelParameters.label: Context Length
modelParameters.description: 支持的最大上下文长度

curl.installLine: 说明：macOS / Linux 一般已预装 curl
curl.code:
curl -X POST "https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"model-name","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"请写一个 Python 函数计算斐波那契数列"}],"temperature":0.7,"max_tokens":4096}'

agentIntegrations.name: Codex
agentIntegrations.description: Configure MaaS as an OpenAI-compatible model provider.
agentIntegrations.zhDescription: 将 MaaS 配置为 Codex 的 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商。
agentIntegrations.code:
model = "qwen-max"
model_provider = "maas"

[model_providers.maas]
name = "MaaS"
base_url = "https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v1"
env_key = "MAAS_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
